verdict.seen: A small cutaway engine box on the wooden floor shows two cylinders with pistons and a crankshaft, with spark plugs on top. It is small but readable.
Close-up of the engine cutaway with two cylinders and pistons that stay in the same place across the three frames. The spark plugs are visible on top.
Blue flame appears at the top of both cylinders above the pistons from the first frame to the later ones, so the spark and burning are visible.
A wide shot of the house wall with a tiny engine far from the camera on the floor. The pistons and crankshaft are too small to see, and no up-and-down motion or spinning can be made out.
verdict.problem: The engine is tiny and far away, so the pistons and crankshaft can't be seen moving. Move the camera in close on the engine cutaway.

verdict.seen: The same wide shot with the engine as a tiny dark box on the floor, and the camera drifting upward. The engine can't be seen running.
verdict.problem: The engine is too small to read as a running engine. Frame the whole engine large in the center of the shot.
